results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Parental leave
results.text: The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. The secondary caregiver receives 6 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Parental leave must start within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Limits
results.text: Client meals may cost up to $120 per person. A director must approve any client meal over $500 in total.

results.title: Travel Policy
results.heading: Taxis and rideshare
results.text: Taxis and rideshare are reimbursable on business trips. Rental cars need manager approval.

results.title: Code of Conduct
results.heading: Disclosure
results.text: Employees must disclose any outside job, board seat or investment in a supplier to Compliance within 30 days.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Submission deadline
results.text: Expense claims must be submitted in the finance portal within 30 days of the expense.
